faq: Does this make AI completely safe?

No tool is risk free, and we do not claim that. Rules and filters lower the chance of bad answers, and approval steps put a person in charge of anything important. We tell you plainly what risk remains.
We are not a law firm, so we do not give legal advice. We build common-sense controls and document them, which your lawyer can review against rules that apply to you, such as privacy or industry law.
Can you add this to a tool someone else built?
Yes, if we can edit its instructions or place a filter in front of it. We review how it is built first and tell you what can and cannot be changed.
What about children or sensitive topics?

We can block or redirect topics such as health, money or minors, and set the tool to hand over to a person. We follow the platform rules of the AI provider you use, and help you add an age or disclaimer notice.
